correctness.rationale: The proof derives a complete bijection of admissible patterns and types, decomposes each forbidden-clique test by parameter component, applies exact inclusion-exclusion to one-edge, incident two-edge and triangle configurations, and proves a strict gap for every other internal graph. Probability estimates follow from finite sums of distinct exponential bases; an independent implementation of the graph constraints passed 294912 local assignments and 4800 two-block tests. Computations corroborate, not replace, the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact triple-type exponential spectrum is a natural higher-arity refinement of finite Henson type counting, and its upper-base hierarchy exhibits an unexpected conditional concentration: despite edges being exponentially rare, two present edges are overwhelmingly incident rather than disjoint. This provides an explicit all-arity structural classification of leading strata, not a relabeling or an arbitrary finite sample.
